Kernkraftwerk

A location where radiation protection matters.

Aktivitäten

Check your protection and radiation indicator before entering. Official updates recommend radiation-resistant military armour for plant runs.

Ertrag

Look for military boxes in radiation zones; they usually contain more Scrap than ordinary crates.

Risiken

Radiation is a continuing hazard, and no specific box or item is guaranteed.

Recycler

For recycling, visit a gas station, parking lot, town, warehouse, Lumberjack or Miner.
